principles: Reuse the existing signed-workspace / configuredGitRootStatus resolution; no second resolver
Guidance text and nesting-check cwd only; never change bootstrap behavior, gate semantics, or git command text
Plain non-git projects with no configured gitRoot stay byte-identical
Stay out of lattice doctor (B-1637) and the already-fixed sites
drivers: External report fix #3: configured-gitRoot users are wrongly told to git init the metadata root
The bootstrap already works, so the misleading guidance and the spurious fatal line are pure UX noise
A reusable gitRoot resolution already exists in session.ts

options.name: A: gitRoot-aware guidance + nesting check in the resolved gitRoot
B: only suppress the fatal stderr, leave the guidance
cons: Leaves the misleading git-init guidance, the bigger half of the report

options.name: C: broad sweep of all metadataRoot git probes
cons: Overlaps B-1637 (doctor) and risks collisions; scope creep

chosen: A: gitRoot-aware guidance + nesting check in the resolved gitRoot
rationale: Option A makes the session.ts git-readiness guidance gitRoot-aware (reusing the existing configuredGitRootStatus resolution) and runs/guards the nesting check in the resolved gitRoot, fixing both halves of the report fix #3 with a minimal, plain-repo-byte-identical change. B leaves the worse half (misleading guidance); C overlaps B-1637 and risks collisions.
